attr.title: retsend
attr.desc: Send and receive files between this device and your phone or PC over wifi, using the LocalSend protocol — no cable, no SSH. Works with the official LocalSend apps. Gamepad-first UI: a radar of nearby devices, transfer dialogs, and an on-screen keyboard.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Install LocalSend on your phone or PC (localsend.org), connect both devices to the same wifi, and they will find each other.
